blends.name: Surströmming!
blends.desc:
Hint(s):
Surströmming is a psuedo-cheese created by fish fermented in brine.

Tip(s):
* Hold to make "Bait" backed by wax tokens
* Drop rate for "Bait" based on previous' day community fishing drop rate
* Drop rate for "Brine" is low at 1:99

blends.name: Find Fish
blends.desc:
Hint(s):
Use "Bait" nfts to attempt to fish up a "Fish" nft.

Tip(s):
* Resell to [wax.fish](https://wax.fish) for wax token rewards
* Blend to mint rare "Fish Bait" 
* rate of success : 1:31
